title: Compton Scattering

step_1_compton_wavelength_from_vortex.title: Deriving λ_C from Electron Vortex Geometry
step_1_compton_wavelength_from_vortex.premise: From SDT Rydberg paper, the electron vortex has characteristic wavelength related to its circulation.

de_broglie_at_c.statement: When electron moves at speed c, its de Broglie wavelength equals the Compton wavelength

vortex_interpretation.statement: The Compton wavelength is the circumference of the electron vortex core divided by 2π
vortex_interpretation.physical_meaning: Characteristic size of electron vortex structure

step_2_scattering_kinematics.title: Wave-Vortex Momentum Transfer
step_2_scattering_kinematics.premise: X-ray is a spation wave with momentum p = E/c. Scattering transfers momentum to electron vortex.

initial_state.electron: at rest, E_e = m_e c², p_e = 0

step_3_wavelength_shift_derivation.title: Deriving the Compton Formula
derivation_steps: From energy conservation: E'_e = E_γ - E'_γ + m_e c²
From momentum conservation: p'_e² = p_γ² + p'_γ² - 2p_γ p'_γ cos(θ)
Squaring energy equation: E'_e² = (E_γ - E'_γ + m_e c²)²
p'_e²c² + m_e²c⁴ = (E_γ - E'_γ)² + 2(E_γ - E'_γ)m_e c² + m_e²c⁴
(p_γ² + p'_γ² - 2p_γ p'_γ cos θ)c² = (E_γ - E'_γ)² + 2(E_γ - E'_γ)m_e c²
E_γ² + E'_γ² - 2E_γ E'_γ cos θ = E_γ² - 2E_γ E'_γ + E'_γ² + 2(E_γ - E'_γ)m_e c²
-2E_γ E'_γ cos θ = -2E_γ E'_γ + 2(E_γ - E'_γ)m_e c²
E_γ E'_γ (1 - cos θ) = (E_γ - E'_γ)m_e c²
converting_to_wavelength: h²c²(1 - cos θ)/(λλ') = hc(λ' - λ)m_e c²/(λλ')
λ' - λ = h(1 - cos θ)/(m_e c)
step_3_wavelength_shift_derivation.final_formula: Δλ = (h/m_e c)(1 - cos θ) = λ_C(1 - cos θ)

step_5_bound_electron_case.title: Why Bound Electrons Don't Show Compton Shift

sdt_explanation.premise: Bound electron vortex is locked to nuclear pressure field
sdt_explanation.momentum_goes_to_atom: Recoil momentum absorbed by entire atom mass M >> m_e
sdt_explanation.modified_formula: Δλ = (h/Mc)(1 - cos θ) ≈ 0 for M ~ 1836 m_e or more

compton_wavelength.derived_from: de Broglie wavelength at v = c, vortex characteristic size

physical_interpretation.compton_wavelength: Characteristic circumference of electron vortex structure
physical_interpretation.scattering_mechanism: Spation wave (X-ray) transfers momentum to electron vortex
physical_interpretation.bound_electron: Whole-atom recoil when vortex locked to nuclear field

references: SDT Rydberg Spectrum from Helical Standing Waves, Section 9 (Mass from Shunt)
